articles.summary: AI coding agents need better permissions, and so does the code they write. SpiceBox enforces fine-grained permissions on AI coding agents using SpiceDB, while spicedb-dev gives agents the authorization context they need to generate code with proper access control from the start. Both are open source.
articles.title: Introducing SpiceBox and spicedb-dev
